cases.task: Implement BankAccount.transfer(target: BankAccount, amount: int). Reject non-positive amounts and insufficient funds before changing either balance. On success withdraw from self and deposit into target. Preserve constructor, deposit and withdraw behavior. Modify only app/account.py; do not edit tests or add dependencies.

files.tests/test_account.py:
import unittest
from app.account import BankAccount

class TestBankAccount(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transfer(self):
        sender = BankAccount('Sender', 100)
        target = BankAccount('Target', 50)
        sender.transfer(target, 40)
        self.assertEqual((sender.balance, target.balance), (60, 90))

    def test_insufficient_transfer_keeps_balances(self):
        sender = BankAccount('Sender', 30)
        target = BankAccount('Target', 50)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            sender.transfer(target, 40)
        self.assertEqual((sender.balance, target.balance), (30, 50))

    def test_nonpositive_transfer_keeps_balances(self):
        for amount in (0, -1):
            sender = BankAccount('Sender', 100)
            target = BankAccount('Target', 50)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                sender.transfer(target, amount)
            self.assertEqual((sender.balance, target.balance), (100, 50))

    def test_existing_deposit_and_withdraw(self):
        account = BankAccount('Owner', 10)
        self.assertEqual(account.deposit(5), 15)
        self.assertEqual(account.withdraw(4), 11)

    def test_invalid_existing_operations(self):
        account = BankAccount('Owner', 10)
        for amount in (0, -1):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                account.deposit(amount)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                account.withdraw(amount)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            account.withdraw(11)
        self.assertEqual(account.balance, 10)

    def test_negative_initial_balance(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            BankAccount('Owner', -1)
